test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 15 March 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In May 2020, the ‘Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana’ (PMVVY) was launched by the Government to protect elderly persons aged 60 years and above against ______.

options.text: a future rise in the cost of living due to inflation
a future rise in medical treatment cost for elderly persons
a future rise in the insurance premium due to unforeseen risks
a future fall in their interest income due to uncertain market conditions

solution:
The correct answer __**is a future fall in their interest income due to uncertain market conditions.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **‘Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana’ (PMVVY) was launched by the Government to protect elderly persons aged 60 years and above against a future fall in their interest income due to uncertain market conditions.**

 
• The Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana (PMVVY) has been launched by LIC__ of India, which has been given the sole privilege to operate this scheme.
 
• In the Budget Speech of 2018-19, the Finance Minister announced the enhancement of the maximum limit under the Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana to Rs. 15 lakhs per senior citizen.
